visualCharacteristics.structure: equation graphic: highlighted blue result block (symbol + label), large '=' operator, then one or more light grey panels of terms (serif symbol over small descriptions) separated by small +/- operators; a flagged operator splits panels; optional italic footnote

contentPattern: one row per item in reading order: [symbol | description paragraphs | optional split flag]; row 1 is the result; operator rows have only a symbol; description-only rows are footnotes
reuseGuidance: Use for any symbolic formula (premium, rate or cost calculations). Do not use for prose explanations or tables.
